topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Depending on the type of account you held with your former broker-dealer, you may find that there are taxes, penalties or restrictions for selling or moving your securities.
answer: When opening a new brokerage account and moving investments from an old one, check whether the new broker will accept each security: it may not accept all of them. You may be able to leave securities the new broker won’t accept with your former broker, or sell them and transfer the cash instead. Selling may involve commissions or other fees, and selling or moving securities can involve taxes, penalties, or restrictions depending on the type of account you held. So, don’t assume every holding can be transferred or that selling or moving it is free of consequences; ask the brokers about the specific securities and account involved.
